newsitem.title: CHINA: China reshuffles gold administration officials.
newsitem.headline: China reshuffles gold administration officials.

text.p: China has appointed a new chief of the Gold Control Administration after the former top official retired, state media and officials said on Friday.

The Ministry of Metallurgical Industry on Monday appointed Wang Dexue to replace Jiao Zhi as director of its Gold Control Administration, the China Gold newspaper said in its July 10 edition seen in Beijing on Friday.

The reshuffle was because Jiao had turned 60 years old and was retiring, and did not mark any policy change, an official with the administration said by telephone. Jiao had held the post since March 1994.
Cheng Fumin would be the administration's vice-director, the newspaper said.
Zhou Shulian had been chosen to be the Communist Party secretary of the state-run gold monopoly China Gold Co, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
